heroHeadline: Iran Blockade Capability Weakening as Hormuz Crude Exports Rebound to ~80% of Pre-Crisis Levels
heroSubtitle: Middle East crude exports have recovered to approximately 80% of pre-conflict levels — up from 72% just one day prior — as Iran's sustained interdiction campaign is assessed as increasingly exhausted under continuing US Navy passage-protection operations
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
